title: Introductory it
note: Empty-subject it — front-chunk production gaps + sentence-choice quiz. · Bank 48 · Type redesign #2 2026-07-26 · Match off · RUE2 TRANSPLANT 2026-08-25: blocks+intro restored from rue2-grok-v1.0 (James-smoked, quality=good_draft); auto-authored bank superseded. · 2026-08-28 smoke: intro C9 (tables/examples, no body); Quiz chips = dummy it vs drop-it vs there (quiz_axis it_subject); Use = fix-the-sentence, A2/B1, one it-subject error. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: B3/B19 all 46 gap items had no chips (and the (possible) cue was a B19 EXACT) — each now offers the answer, the dropped-it calque (Is important…), and the there- version, which is the axis the pack note already named. D1 three explanations covered all 46; each now says which job the empty it is doing — propping up a that-clause, filling the slot before a to-clause, weather and the clock, or a fixed frame. D3 the getting-late item carried two Czech prompts joined with a slash. A8 four twins closed.

items.en: It is important to practise every day.

items.wrong: There is important to practise every day.

items.explanation: **It takes** is a fixed English frame with an empty **it** in front. Drop the it and the sentence has no subject. It takes patience to learn grammar.
items.explanation_cz: **It takes** je pevná anglická vazba s prázdným **it** vepředu. Bez it věta nemá podmět. It takes patience to learn grammar.
items.wrong: Takes patience to learn grammar.

items.en: It is getting late.
accepts: It is getting late.
It's getting late.
It was getting late.
items.explanation: Weather, the clock and how things are take an empty **it**: **It is**. Czech has no subject here at all — Začíná být pozdě.
items.explanation_cz: Počasí, hodiny a jak to je berou prázdné **it**: **It is**. Čeština tu podmět nemá vůbec — Začíná být pozdě.
items.wrong: Is getting late.
